name: stac-health-extension
description: STAC Health Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections

scripts.test: npm run validate:valid && npm run validate:invalid
scripts.validate:invalid: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of fs.readdirSync('examples').filter(f=>f.startsWith('invalid-'))){ try{ execSync('npx stac-node-validator examples/'+f+' --schemaMap https://vitalstac.github.io/health/v0.1.0/schema.json=./json-schema/schema.json',{stdio:'ignore'}); console.error('FEHLER: '+f+' hätte fehlschlagen müssen!'); process.exit(1); }catch(e){ console.log('OK (erwartet fehlgeschlagen): '+f); } }"
